info.name: OAN A2C — REST API v1 (Full Sequential Runner)
info.description:
Production REST API v1 Postman Collection for OpenAgriNet Access to Credit (OAN A2C).
Structured for sequential runner execution covering Admin Master Data, Bank Onboarding, Product Cataloging, Lead & Consent CRM, Underwriting Workflow, and Farmer Self-Service B2C.
